integrity: Full symbolic case analysis supports every size; exhaustive finite verification is supplementary and does not prove asymptotic or universal statements.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to synchronous strict-neighbor binary majority with tie retention on labelled balanced three-partite graphs. Gaussian limits require independent fair initial labels. Novelty remains a best-knowledge judgment; no independent audit.
title: A persistent majority-reversal probability and rare oscillatory basins on balanced tripartite graphs
